content.text:
Only one code in the CPRD Read code lists matches eosinophilic oesophagitis (the US spelling is eosinophilic esophagitis).

| Read code | Term |
|:--|:--|
| J1017 | Eosinophilic oesophagitis |

I searched on "eosinophilic oesophagitis", "eosinophilic esophagitis" and "eosinophilic oesophag". All three returned only J1017. A search for "eosinophilic gastro" found nothing, so there are no separate eosinophilic gastroenteritis codes to consider. I also checked the neighbouring J101 codes (reflux, Barrett's, other oesophagitis). I left them out because none of them describes eosinophilic disease.
